speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what is the percentage of standard versus non-standard drugs prescribed for MediFund assistance patients in comparison to non-MediFund assistance patients in restructured hospitals; and (b) what is the governance in place to ensure appropriate prescribing of non-standard drugs for MediFund assistance patients.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: To guide appropriate utilisation of drugs, the Ministry of Health's (MOH's) Agency for Care Effectiveness (ACE) publishes guidelines on the appropriate use of selected standard drugs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Where clinically appropriate, drugs that are not on the lists may also be accorded financial assistance on a case-by-case basis.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Each public healthcare institution also has governance in place to ensure appropriate drug utilisation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: For example, Pharmacy and Therapeutic Committees evaluate drugs for inclusion in their hospital drug formulary and guide doctors on the drugs to use in the course of treating their patients.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: MOH shares the Member's concern that patients should be prescribed the drugs that are appropriate for them.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: MOH will continue to remind our healthcare institutions to do so and also strengthen our governance processes where necessary.
